additional_info.subject: Re: 0446817 - ID0446817-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP/R3 170001699] Black screen issue CRM:02916000004
additional_info.body:
Dear Bart,
Thank you for the quotation regarding the screen replacement for our Sicharge D300 charging station.
Before proceeding, we would kindly like to ask whether it would be possible to perform an on-site diagnosis first. Since the exact cause of the issue has not yet been determined, it might also be related to a poor connection or another technical fault rather than the screen itself.
Ideally, we would appreciate if a technician could investigate the problem on-site and, depending on the findings, either resolve the issue directly or proceed with the screen replacement if confirmed necessary.
Please let us know if this approach is possible and if you could propose a suitable time for the visit.
Thank you in advance for your support.
Best regards,
Olivier Vanhamel
E-Load
